hooks.name: Pre-write terraform fmt
hooks.description: Before writing a .tf or .tfvars file, check terraform fmt. Warns if formatting is needed but does not block.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path','') or d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tf|tfvars)$' && command -v terraform &>/dev/null; then
  # Write content to temp file and check fmt
  CONTENT=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('text','') or d.get('newStr',''))" 2>/dev/null)
  TMPFILE=$(mktemp /tmp/tfcheck-XXXX.tf)
  echo "$CONTENT" > "$TMPFILE"
  terraform fmt -check "$TMPFILE" 2>/dev/null \
    && echo "✓ terraform fmt OK" \
    || echo "⚠ terraform fmt needed — run: terraform fmt $FILE"
  rm -f "$TMPFILE"
fi
